title: Worth the time
text:
It was worth the visit; it is relatively small but the replicas of the villages are fine. 
There is a good supply of art workshops; bars and restaurants although a little raised in price. 

The museum inside the park includes some samples of Miro; Dali and Picasso
author: Ricardo F

title: Experience 🥇
text: Don’t hesitate to enter you can get to know a lot of Spain and its important parties 🥳 I recommend it 💪🏼👍🏼👏🏼👌🏼✌🏻
author: alvarotaiq
